title: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act
full_text:
Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to establish the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology to contribute to the development of national ocean science and technology and the securing of international competitiveness through systematic research and development, management and utilization of the ocean and marine and fisheries resources, and the training of outstanding professionals in the marine field. <Amended 2017.4.18>

Article 2 (Legal Personality)
The Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") shall be a corporation.

Article 3 (Establishment)
(1) The Institute shall be established upon registration of its incorporation at the location of its principal office.
(2) Matters necessary for registration of the Institute's incorporation and other registrations shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 4 (Offices, Etc.)
(1) The location of the Institute's principal office shall be prescribed by its articles of incorporation.
(2) The Institute may establish affiliated institutions or branch institutes, as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.

Article 5 (Articles of Incorporation)
(1) The Institute's articles of incorporation shall state the following matters:
1. Its purpose;
2. Its name;
3. The location of its principal office;
4. Matters concerning its affairs and their execution;
5. Matters concerning property and accounting;
6. Matters concerning executives and employees;
7. Matters concerning the board of directors;
8. Matters concerning amendments to the articles of incorporation;
9. Matters concerning the method of public notice;
10. Other matters necessary for the organization and operation of the Institute.
(2) The Institute shall obtain authorization from the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries when amending its articles of incorporation. <Amended 2013.3.23>

Article 6 (Guarantee of Autonomous Management, Etc.)
The Institute shall be guaranteed independence and autonomy in research and management.

Article 7 (Officers)
(1) The Institute shall have no more than 15 directors, including one chairperson of the board of directors and one President, and one auditor.
(2) Directors shall consist of persons falling under the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as "ex officio directors") and persons elected by the board of directors as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. In such cases, directors other than ex officio directors shall obtain approval from the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended 2013.3.23, 2017.7.26, 2025.10.1>
1. The President of the Institute;
2. One person each designated by the Minister of Planning and Budget, the Minister of Science and ICT, and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries from among public officials in general service belonging to the Senior Civil Service of their respective ministries;
3. The president of Korea Maritime and Ocean University (meaning Korea Maritime and Ocean University located in Busan Metropolitan City; hereinafter the same shall apply).
(3) The chairperson of the board of directors shall be elected from among the directors as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, subject to approval by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended 2013.3.23>
(4) The chairperson of the board of directors shall not concurrently serve as President of the Institute.
(5) The auditor shall be elected by the board of directors as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, subject to approval by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended 2013.3.23>
(6) Officers other than the President and the auditor shall serve part-time.
(7) The auditor shall audit the affairs and accounts of the Institute.
(8) The duties and terms of office of officers and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 8 (Board of Directors)
(1) A board of directors shall be established within the Institute to deliberate and decide on important matters of the Institute.
(2) The board of directors shall consist of the directors, including the chairperson of the board of directors.
(3) The chairperson of the board of directors shall convene and preside over meetings of the board of directors.
(4) The auditor may attend meetings of the board of directors and state opinions.
(5) Other matters concerning the board of directors shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 9 (President)
(1) The Institute shall have a President.
(2) The President shall represent the Institute and have overall responsibility for its affairs.
(3) The President shall be elected by the board of directors as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, subject to approval by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended 2013.3.23>
(4) The duties and term of office of the President and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 10 (Contributions)
(1) The State, a local government, or a public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions may provide contributions to the Institute to cover expenses incurred in its establishment, construction, research, and operation, and in the training of outstanding professionals in the marine field.
(2) Matters necessary for the provision and use of contributions under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 11 (Special Cases concerning Permission to Use or Lease State or Public Property)
(1) Where necessary for the establishment and operation of the Institute, the State or a local government may grant the Institute permission to use or lease State property and commodities free of charge under a private contract, notwithstanding the State Property Act and the Commodity Management Act, and may grant the Institute permission to use or lease public property and commodities free of charge, or sell such property and commodities to the Institute, under a private contract, notwithstanding the Public Property and Commodity Management Act.
(2) Where permission to use or a lease of public property is granted under paragraph (1), the period thereof may be up to 20 years, notwithstanding Articles 21 and 31 of the Public Property and Commodity Management Act. In such cases, the period may be renewed, and each renewal period shall not exceed 20 years.
(3) Where permission to use or a lease of land owned by a local government is granted under paragraph (1), permanent facilities may be constructed on the land, notwithstanding Article 13 of the Public Property and Commodity Management Act, on the condition that the land be purchased upon expiration of the period of permission for use or lease. In such cases, notwithstanding the latter part of paragraph (2), the period of permission for use or lease may be renewed until the total period of permission for use or lease reaches 50 years.
(4) Where the Institute is required to purchase land owned by a local government under the former part of paragraph (3), the head of the local government may allow the purchase price to be paid in installments over a period of up to 20 years, notwithstanding Article 37 of the Public Property and Commodity Management Act.

Article 12 (Profit-Making Business)
(1) The Institute may conduct profit-making business to the extent that it does not impede research, development, and human resources development activities, as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) Profits under paragraph (1) shall be used to finance the management of the Institute.

Article 13 (Business Year)
The business year of the Institute shall conform to the fiscal year of the Government.

Article 14 (Submission of Business Plans)
(1) The Institute shall submit a business plan and a budget to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries for approval before the beginning of each business year, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) The Institute shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries a statement of settlement of revenues and expenditures for each business year, audited by a certified public accountant or an accounting firm designated by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(3) Among the matters included in a statement of settlement under paragraph (2), any matter falling under any of the following items may be excluded from the accounting audit by a certified public accountant or an accounting firm:
1. Research activities involving State secrets;
2. Activities directly related to those specified in item 1;
3. Research activities within projects commissioned by enterprises for which the commissioning enterprises or other such parties have requested protection of confidentiality.

Article 15 (Support and Coordination)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall support and foster the Institute and coordinate and supervise its activities. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) The State shall provide stable financial support to the Institute so as to contribute to promoting its research and development, developing outstanding specialists in the marine field, and strengthening its international competitiveness.

Article 16 (Appointment and Dismissal of Employees)
Employees of the Institute shall be appointed and dismissed by the President, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 17 (Concurrent Positions)
(1) Employees responsible for research and development at the Institute may concurrently hold positions at marine-related national universities in the Busan area (meaning national universities having departments related to marine and fisheries sciences; hereinafter referred to as "related universities") where necessary to educate and guide students of related universities and conduct academic research.
(2) Educational public officials serving at related universities may concurrently hold positions at the Institute where necessary to conduct research and development, notwithstanding Article 64 of the State Public Officials Act.
(3) Concurrent service by employees responsible for research and development under paragraph (1) shall be approved by the President at the request of the president of a related university, and the duties, remuneration, and other matters relating to such concurrent service shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(4) Concurrent service by educational public officials under paragraph (2) shall be approved by the president of a related university at the request of the President, and the duties, remuneration, and other matters relating to such concurrent service shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 18 (Donations)
(1) Any person may donate money or other property to the Institute to support the Institute's research and development and the development of outstanding specialists in the marine field.
(2) Where a donation is made under paragraph (1), the Institute may accept it, notwithstanding the Act on Collection and Use of Donations.
(3) A person who donates land, research facilities, research equipment, or other such property as a donation under paragraph (1) may use it jointly with the Institute for a certain period.
(4) Matters necessary for the procedures for making and accepting donations and for joint use under paragraphs (1) through (3), and other matters necessary for the management and use of donated money and goods, shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 19 (Submission of Research Plans and Research Reports)
(1) The Institute shall submit research plans and research reports to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: Provided, That this shall not apply to research conducted under contracts for commissioned research. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review and evaluate the research plans and research reports submitted under the main clause of paragraph (1) and, where necessary, may require necessary measures, such as revision and supplementation of the research plans and the content of the research being conducted, or recommend the dissemination of research results. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 20 (Joint Research on Specific Projects)
Where necessary for joint research on a specific project, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may take appropriate measures necessary therefor or recommend that the President take necessary measures. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 21 (Joint Use of Research Facilities)
To improve research productivity and ensure the efficient use of research facilities, the Institute shall endeavor to use research facilities, equipment, and the like jointly with other research institutes, universities, professional organizations, and the like through mutual consultation. In such cases, the costs shall be borne by the institution using them.

Article 22 (Cooperation with Domestic and Foreign Universities and Research Institutes)
The Institute may cooperate in research with domestic and foreign universities, research institutes, and the like to conduct research activities efficiently.

Article 23 (Prohibition of Use of the Same Name)
No person other than the Institute under this Act may use the name "Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology."

Article 24 (Duty to Maintain Confidentiality)
Officers and employees of the Institute, or persons who formerly held such positions, shall not disclose or misappropriate any secret learned in the course of performing their duties.

Article 25 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of the Civil Act)
Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated foundations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Institute.

Article 26 (Deeming as Public Officials for Purposes of Applying Penalty Provisions)
Officers and employees of the Institute shall be deemed public officials when applying Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act.

Article 27 (Penalty Provisions)
A person who discloses or misappropriates a secret in violation of Article 24 shall be punished by imprisonment with or without labor for not more than three years or by a fine not exceeding 30 million won. <Amended on March 21, 2017>

Article 28 (Administrative Fines)
(1) A person who uses the name "Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology" in violation of Article 23 shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding one million won.
(2) Administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

ADDENDA <Act No. 11145, Dec. 31, 2011>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Preparatory Committee for Establishment)
(1) Before this Act enters into force, the Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs shall establish a preparatory committee for the establishment of the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as the "Preparatory Committee for Establishment"), composed of the preparatory committee members under paragraph (2), to handle affairs concerning the dissolution of the former Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute under the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutions (hereinafter referred to as the "Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute") and the establishment of the Institute.
(2) The Preparatory Committee for Establishment shall be composed of not more than 10 members, including a chairperson, and the chairperson and members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs.

Article 3 (Procedures for Establishment)
(1) The Preparatory Committee for Establishment shall prepare the articles of incorporation of the Institute and obtain authorization from the Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs.
(2) Notwithstanding Article 7 (2) and (5), the directors and auditor at the time of establishment shall be appointed by the Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs.
(3) When the directors and auditor have been appointed pursuant to paragraph (2), the Preparatory Committee for Establishment shall, without delay, register the establishment of the Institute under the joint names of its members and then transfer its affairs to the President.
(4) The preparatory committee members shall be deemed to have been dismissed from their commissions upon completion of the transfer of affairs under paragraph (3).

Article 4 (Special Cases concerning Appointment of Chairperson of the Board of Directors and President)
(1) Notwithstanding Article 7 (3), the chairperson of the board of directors at the time of establishment of the Institute pursuant to this Act shall be the president of Korea Maritime and Ocean University.
(2) Notwithstanding Article 9 (3), the President at the time of establishment of the Institute pursuant to this Act shall be the President of the Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute, and the term of office shall be the remainder of the term of office under Article 12 (3) of the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutions.

Article 5 (Special Cases concerning Dissolution and Liquidation)
The Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute shall be deemed to have been dissolved upon the establishment of the Institute pursuant to this Act, notwithstanding the provisions concerning the dissolution, etc. of research institutions in the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutions and the provisions concerning the dissolution and liquidation of corporations in the Civil Act.

Article 6 (Transitional Measures concerning Employees)
Employees of the former Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute shall be deemed to have been employed as employees of the Institute upon its establishment.

Article 7 (Transitional Measures concerning Budget at Time of Establishment)
(1) The Institute established pursuant to this Act may execute the budget under the control of the former Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute in accordance with previous practice until the Institute's budget is finalized at the time of its establishment.
(2) When the Institute's budget is adopted, expenses executed pursuant to paragraph (1) shall be deemed to have been executed in accordance with the budget so adopted.

Article 8 (Transitional Measures concerning Succession to Rights and Obligations)
(1) Upon its establishment, the Institute shall succeed, in their entirety, to all property, including affiliated institutions, and all rights and obligations belonging to the Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute at the time this Act enters into force.
(2) The name of the Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute appearing in registers and other public records shall be deemed to be the name of the Institute.
(3) The value of the property succeeded to by the Institute shall be deemed to be its book value on the day immediately preceding the date of establishment of the Institute.

Article 9 (Transitional Measures concerning Penalty Provisions)
The former Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutions shall apply to the application of penalty provisions to acts committed before this Act enters into force.

Article 10 (Amendment to Other Act)
The Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutions is partially amended as follows:
Item 13 in the institution names column of the Annex shall be deleted.

Article 11 (Relationship to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Where other statutes or regulations refer to the Korea Ocean Research and Development Institute at the time this Act enters into force, such references shall be deemed to refer to the Institute under this Act.
(2) Where other statutes or regulations refer to government-funded research institutions or research institutions, etc. established pursuant to the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutions, each such reference shall be deemed to include the Institute established pursuant to this Act, and the relevant statutes or regulations shall apply accordingly.
